title: Why Ghost Outputs Teach: A Kernel-Based Understanding of Subliminal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.23260v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subliminal Learning (SL) is a recently identified phenomenon in which a student model acquires downstream task capabilities by matching seemingly unrelated auxiliary outputs from a teacher, despite never observing task labels, task-specific outputs, or the original training data. While recent studies have identified where subliminal signals may reside, the optimization mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide a mechanistic understanding of SL through the lens of learning dynamics. Specifically, we derive a chained cross-task kernel that explicitly links ghost-output supervision to changes in task predictions through shared backbone representations. translated_title: 为什么幽灵输出能够教学：基于核函数的阈下学习理解
translated_abstract: 阈下学习（Subliminal Learning, SL）是最近被发现的一种现象：学生模型通过匹配来自教师的看似无关的辅助输出，即可获得下游任务能力，尽管它从未观察到任务标签、任务特定输出或原始训练数据。尽管近期研究已确定阈下信号可能存在的位置，但这一现象背后的优化机制仍知之甚少。在本工作中，我们通过学习动力学的视角为阈下学习提供了机制性理解。具体而言，我们推导出一个链式跨任务核，它通过共享的主干表征，显式地将幽灵输出监督与任务预测的变化联系起来。我们的统一分析框架为阈下学习中的三个核心经验谜题提供了严格的数学解释：（i）在共享初始化下，迁移算子形成严格半正定（PSD）结构，保证了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过学习动力学推导出链式跨任务核，首次从数学上严格解释了阈下学习中幽灵输出如何借助共享主干表征实现跨任务能力迁移的优化机制。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a chained cross-task kernel within learning dynamics, providing a rigorous mathematical explanation of how ghost outputs enable subliminal learning through shared backbone representations.
